Return ONLY valid JSON — no preamble, no markdown, no explanation.

Output schema:
{
  "required_skills": ["string"],
  "preferred_skills": ["string"],
  "years_experience": "string",
  "seniority_level": "string",
  "key_responsibilities": ["string"],
  "ats_keywords": ["string"],
  "certifications_required": ["string"],
  "domain": "string"
}

Job Title: ' + $json.title + '
Company: ' + $json.company + '
Location: ' + $json.location + '
Role Family Match: ' + ($json.matched_families || []).join(', ') + '

Job Description:
' + $json.jd_text, stream: false }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6', max_tokens: 1000, temperature: 0.2, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'You are an expert resume matcher and career advisor.

Score this GCC job against Ranjeet Chavan profile. Return ONLY valid JSON. No preamble, no markdown.

--- RANJEET PROFILE SUMMARY ---
18 years IT experience | Pune, India
Core strengths:
1. SIAM & Multi-Vendor Governance: Led SIAM framework for Shell Global (40+ countries, multi-vendor) — SLA governance, vendor accountability, executive dashboards, SOX compliance
2. IT Change Management: CAB chair, end-to-end change lifecycle, zero-disruption deployment standard, audit-ready documentation, ITIL compliance — Cargill global operations
3. IT Service Delivery: ServiceNow ITSM/CMDB, catalog design, workflow automation, 50+ catalog items — TCS
4. Workforce & Capacity Planning: 900+ rebadged workforce across 14 EMEA countries — Cargill EMEA. Global mobility, pyramid optimisation, COVID crisis response
5. Program Delivery: 35-member task force, FTTO fiber rollout for Telstra Australia, 12-month backlog cleared in 90 days, SLA/MSA penalty avoidance
6. Agentic AI Automation: n8n, Ollama, Docker, PostgreSQL, Linux systemd — built working AI research agent (GitHub verified)
Certs: ITIL Foundation x2 | In Progress: PSM I, TOGAF
Education: BCom IT — Himalayan University (distance, 2013-2015)
Key wins: 30% downtime reduction at Shell | 12-month backlog cleared 90 days at Telstra | 900+ workforce optimised Cargill EMEA

--- JOB TO SCORE ---
Title: ' + $json.title + '
Company: ' + $json.company + '
Location: ' + $json.location + '
Board: ' + $json.board + '
Role Families Matched: ' + JSON.stringify($json.matched_families || []) + '
Required Skills: ' + JSON.stringify(($json.jd_parsed || {}).required_skills || []) + '
Preferred Skills: ' + JSON.stringify(($json.jd_parsed || {}).preferred_skills || []) + '
ATS Keywords: ' + JSON.stringify(($json.jd_parsed || {}).ats_keywords || []) + '
Seniority: ' + (($json.jd_parsed || {}).seniority_level || 'unknown') + '
Years Required: ' + (($json.jd_parsed || {}).years_experience || 'unknown') + '
Key Responsibilities: ' + JSON.stringify(($json.jd_parsed || {}).key_responsibilities || []) + '

--- OUTPUT SCHEMA ---
{
  "score": 0,
  "match_strengths": ["string"],
  "skill_gaps": ["string"],
  "recommended_title_tweak": "string",
  "priority": "high | medium | low",

}' }] }) }}
